subject: Senior ratification requested — Hosted API 30% concession for AcmeHealth pilot
messages:
From: Alex Grant <alex.grant@acmehealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: hosted api pilot pricing concession

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the KV caching behavior. We want to move forward with an initial pilot (hosted API) across two product teams: Clinical NLP and Insights.

Quick ask from our side: given the size of the potential expansion (we expect to scale to ~200M tokens/month within 9–12 months if the pilot goes well), can Redwood offer a 30% concession off list hosted API usage pricing for the pilot period (first 6 months)? We can make this richer by doing a 12-month committed spend with a prepay of $200k, and sign the SOW ASAP.

Attached: draft SOW and a simple volume/usage forecast.

Happy to hop on a call if helpful. Need to get this into our procurement timeline (they asked for pricing confirmation by 5/21).

Best,
Alex Grant
Director, Platform Partnerships
AcmeHealth

Attachments: SOW_AcmeHealth_v2.pdf (pdf), AcmeHealth_pricing_model_v3.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: hosted api pilot pricing concession — exec ratification needed

Team — forwarding inbound from Acme (see below). They want a 30% off list for the pilot (6 months) but are open to a 12-month commitment and prepay. Key facts:
- ARR potential: expansion to ~200M tokens/mo within 9–12 months (sales forecast attached).
- Proposed concession: 30% off Hosted API list for pilot months; they will commit to a 12-month agreement if pilot metrics hit; proposed prepay $200k.
- Impact: at our current blended unit economics this is ~30–35% unit margin erosion vs. baseline for the pilot period — but the strategic upside is large (enterprise reference, potential MR revenue).

Request: Need senior ratification to offer 30% given this is >20% (deal desk limit). Proposed guardrails if approved:
1) 12-month minimum commitment with monthly minimums (no less than $35k/mo billed).
2) 50% of the prepay required up front (we can negotiate full prepay).
3) Auto-reprice clause after month 6 if usage < 40% of forecast (reverts to 15% concession).
4) SOW to include success metrics and opt-out triggers.

I recommend approval conditional on finance + legal sign-off on the minimums above. Ben / Mina / Marcus — can you review and advise by EOD 5/18? Procurement at Acme wants numbers for their internal review Friday.

Thanks — this is a solid strategic anchor and could accelerate other deals in the healthcare vertical.

—Tessa
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: 415-555-0123
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: hosted api pilot pricing concession — exec ratification needed

Tessa —

Quick clarifying Qs before I escalate to CEO:
- What does the $200k prepay cover (months 1–6 or full 12)?
- What's the worst-case realized revenue if usage stays at 30% of forecast? I want to see net revenue and gross margin impact for months 1–6 and 7–12.

High-level: 30% is larger than we'd like to standardize, but if we secure a 12-month commitment + meaningful prepay and a rollback clause, I can support an exception. Need finance model to justify.

Ben
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: hosted api pilot pricing concession — exec ratification needed

Ben / team — ran a quick model against the attached pricing sheet (AcmeHealth_pricing_model_v3.xlsx). Findings:
- If prepay = $200k covering first 6 months, our net cash is good and we can absorb the unit margin compression for the pilot.
- Worst-case scenario (usage at 30% of forecast): net revenue for first 6 months would be ~$140k (after concession), gross margin would be ~18% for that period. That's low but acceptable for a strategic reference account provided we protect the back half of the year (months 7–12).

Conditions I will sign off on for a 30% concession:
1) Full $200k prepay required before contract start (we can accept staged payments but prefer full upfront).
2) 12-month term with a minimum annual spend guarantee of $350k.
3) Auto-reprice: if cumulative usage through month 6 < 40% of forecast, concession drops to 15% for remaining months and refunds are not issued (prepay stays).
4) Legal to include a clause allowing us to terminate pilot for cause if repeated misconfiguration/abuse is detected.

If the customer will not prepay the $200k, I cannot approve 30% — we can offer 20% with standard terms.

Mina
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Grant <alex.grant@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <legal@acmehealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: hosted api pilot pricing concession — approval and next steps

Alex — good news: senior leadership has agreed to the 30% concession for the pilot, subject to the conditional terms below. Thanks for negotiating in good faith.

Final terms Redwood is prepared to sign:
- 30% concession off list Hosted API usage pricing for pilot months 1–6.
- Customer commits to a 12-month term with a minimum annual spend guarantee of $350,000.
- $200,000 prepay due before contract start (we can accept two installments: $125k at signing, $75k within 30 days — preference is full upfront).
- Auto-reprice clause: if cumulative usage through month 6 < 40% of forecast, concession will reduce to 15% for the remainder of the term. No refunds on prepay.
- SOW to capture success metrics and Redwood retention right if usage is persistently below forecast.

Next steps:
1) Can your procurement/legal confirm acceptance of the prepay schedule and minimums?
2) I'll have Legal push an updated SOW + pricing exhibit and DocuSign packet by EOD 5/20.
3) If procurement needs adjustments, please indicate which elements are non-starters.

If Acme signs, we'll schedule a technical onboarding week-of-June 7 and prioritize a runtime performance review to ensure the KV cache and batching profiles are tuned.

—Tessa
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: 415-555-0123

Attachments referenced: SOW_AcmeHealth_v2.pdf, AcmeHealth_pricing_model_v3.xlsx
DocuSign link (upcoming): https://docusign.com/packet/ACME-2027-001
